changelog:
3.2.18 - Re-base onto upstream 3.2.19. Upstream changed 44 files; only
1080i/Includes_Info.xml is one we overlay. 3-way merged.
The first attempt reported a conflict that was PHANTOM: our overlay copy was
CRLF while both upstream sides are LF, so the whole file looked rewritten.
Normalising all three sides first gave 0 conflicts and a real surface of 7
upstream lines and 5 of ours. The file is now written back as LF, matching
upstream, so this trap does not recur on the next re-base -- that is why this
commit shows the file as fully rewritten.
Kept: our KODIRDIL 18px gap so a long Hebrew plot never touches the ratings
row. Gained: upstream's new MyAnimeList rating block. Both verified present
in the merged file, which parses.

Hebrew skin overlay: Rubik/NotoSansHebrew fonts, gearsai subtitle OSD button (Custom_1147), Hebrew info labels.
